Based on the chest X-ray findings in Figure 1a and Figure 1b, what is the most likely diagnosis for the patient's condition, considering the opacity in the upper lobe of the right lung? A) Infectious pneumonia with lobar consolidation  
B) Pulmonary embolism with infarction
